Question 1
?

Which statement is equivalent to M∧(¬N∨R)?

a
(M∧¬N)∨(M∧R)
b
(M∨¬N)∨(M∨R)
c
(M∧¬N)∧(M∧R)
d
(M∨¬N)∧(M∨R)
e
(M∧¬N)∨(M∧¬R)
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We distribute the conjunction over the disjunction, as follows:

M∧(¬N∨R)≡(M∧¬N)∨(M∧R)
